# Podcasts in Spanish

> > Learn Spanish through authentic podcasts featuring real conversations from Spain with leveled content, worksheets, and transcripts for students and teachers.

Podcasts in Spanish offers authentic Spanish learning content created by Bea and David, featuring real conversations recorded in Madrid and throughout Spain. The site provides structured learning materials across multiple proficiency levels with comprehensive worksheets, vocabulary tasks, and audio lessons for both independent learners and Spanish teachers.

## Key Topics

- Spanish learning podcasts
- Real conversations from Spain
- Leveled content (beginner to advanced)
- Spanish worksheets and transcripts
- Vocabulary tasks and audio lessons
- Teacher resources
- Intermediate Spanish (Level 2)
- Advanced Spanish (Level 3)
- Madrid Spanish dialect
- Membership and subscription access
- Free sample materials
- Authentic Spanish content
- Listening comprehension exercises

## Learning Levels

- [Level 2 - Intermediate Spanish](https://podcastsinspanish.org/pages/level2.shtml): Intermediate Spanish podcasts with real conversations from Madrid, Spain
- [Level 3 - Advanced Spanish](https://podcastsinspanish.org/pages/level3.shtml): Advanced Spanish podcasts with listening exercises and worksheets

## Getting Started

- [Homepage](https://podcastsinspanish.org/): Main site for Spanish learning podcasts with leveled content from Spain
- [Free Sample Worksheets](https://podcastsinspanish.org/pages/freesamples.shtml): Free sample worksheets, transcripts and vocabulary tasks for Spanish learners

## Membership

- [Registration and Membership](https://podcastsinspanish.org/pages/registration.shtml): Membership registration with PayPal payment for full access to podcast worksheets
